requirement:
The Python repository you were given has a bug. Fix it in place so the behaviour described in SPEC holds. Keep every public function and its signature, keep the existing tests passing, and add a regression test that would have caught the bug.

SYMPTOM: `slugify('Hello,   World!')` returns 'hello,---world!' instead of 'hello-world'.

SPEC: Lowercase; every run of non-alphanumeric characters becomes ONE '-'; no leading/trailing '-'.

The code is in `lib/slugify.py`; read it from the repository (it is not repeated here).
